statement: This sketch creates a scrolling platformer environment where a character navigates through a world of colorful, blocky platforms. The character responds to keyboard input for movement and jumping, with gravity pulling them downward. The scene scrolls horizontally as the character moves, giving a sense of progression through the level. The visual design uses solid colors and geometric shapes to create an engaging, retro-style platformer aesthetic.
